m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: That ought to do it, there's nothing to do now but wait. Time for you to get her Spirit back - head off to Dreamland or wherever.
You would venture into the Reverie? Beware, Wizard - that place can be dangerous indeed.
The Aethyr surrounding Empyrea makes projection... difficult. But it is weakening.
I will open... the Portal to the Reverie. Go through it quickly!
Do not fear, Wizard. I will guard her as I would the Temple of Light itself.
Mortals are unwelcome here, but I see you are the Scion of Bartleby. You are more than mortal. Welcome.
The Son of Spider is responsible for this? These are troubling tidings. In the Temple of Light we sensed Mellori's distress from afar.
Raven sent portents of something happening in the Dying Jungles that must be stopped. Can it be she meant for me to stop you?
I find, looking upon this Child, that I am moved to help her, and help you. Your hearts are strong, and good.
Mellori must be restored to health. Place her in the light. The Life Magic bound into the great Paradox Chain will sustain her body.
You have brought Mellori to the Cave of Quickening. Let the Chain's light sustain her body, then go seek her spirit.
